assumptions: Unix host has find, grep, basename, sort, tr, sed, printf, test, false, rm and jq. LC_ALL=C is used for deterministic menu ordering in tests.
Only UTF-8 launcher paths are representable by Execute named values. Native find retains recursive discovery order and first duplicate-name match.
Fixture-only BASH_ENV supplies the single mapfile -t use on macOS Bash 3; the upstream source copy is untouched.
Menu, notification, and database helpers are mocked. Every deletion is guarded to the disposable owned HOME.

The host sed dialect is preserved, including BSD sed treating upstream GNU BRE \+ differently; exact expected normalized-icon argv is probed from the host sed. Case-insensitive filesystems may alias original and lowercase icon names, so full tree oracles use actual initial path keys.
known_gaps: Execute has no explicit exit statement or nonzero final-output facility. No-app/empty-selection branches retain status 1 through native false but lose upstream stdout error message and gain an Execute failure diagnostic.

Execute has no stderr redirection. update-desktop-database stdout is discarded on success as upstream; its stderr would remain visible, and native failures add Execute diagnostics. find stderr cannot be suppressed for unreadable traversal errors.
find process-substitution errors are ignored by upstream; Execute pipeline failures are fatal. Missing desktop directories are handled explicitly.
Native failures preserve status and already-completed filesystem effects; failed finite stdout is discarded.
